p2_b0.ocr: The management of acute conditions often necessitates the evaluation of therapeutic interventions to establish their efficacy. One such intervention, sodium bicarbonate therapy, has been extensively studied in the context of various acute metabolic derangements.

p2_b1.ocr: As highlighted in the accompanying table, there are specific acute conditions in which sodium bicarbonate therapy does not yield improved clinical outcomes, particularly in the management of diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA). The data delineates various approaches to treatment, including the analysis of time-dependent metrics and the statistical significance of outcomes represented by β (SE) and P values.
